change.title: Content update: rule 0291 for template T7

verdict.headline: Rule 0291 for template T7 passes validation: new rule processed through pipeline without rejections
verdict.cause: The change adds rule-0291 for template T7 with criteria f02 and f05. Flow: change → rule-0291 interface → rule-validator.validate (checks_against template:T7) → content-pipeline → content-interpreter.load_rules (inputs_supplied=20). In system w-n7v2, two interface contracts exist: template-registry declares field_count=21 for template:T7 (contract ic-0014, row hash:da215d1662fad1c0), and rule-validator.validate checks_against template:T7 with field_count=21 (contract ic-0015, row hash:9c910f3dbb206d9e). Baseline experiment (x-945716a7ee124591): 3 rules checked, 0 rejected, exit_code=0, 50 events processed, 0 matches. Candidate experiment (x-e5938b1e9f684045): 4 rules checked (includes new rule), 0 rejected, exit_code=0, 50 events processed, 0 matches. The new rule is accepted by the validator without rejecting any rules; field_count contract of 21 for template T7 is consistent with the existing rule set.
tested: x-945716a7ee124591: baseline · workload default → all assertions passed
x-e5938b1e9f684045: candidate · workload default → all assertions passed
limitations: Contracts ic-0014 and ic-0015 are specific to system w-n7v2 and may differ in other systems. Experiments use default workload; real-world event patterns may vary. The field_count=21 is a static contract value and does not dynamically adjust per rule addition.
Baseline and candidate both passed under every tested workload.
